text:
Leah C: Quick heads-up — after today's onboarding calls we got 3 recurring asks we should capture and surface to product. TL;DR: per-route billing toggle, embedding match threshold, per-deployment audit logs. Anyone can take notes?
Maya S: I'm on it, will drop raw notes here in 30m.
Ben T: FYI Support saw same per-route billing ask from HelixCardio + Sable.
Sofia G: adding customer quotes: "We need per-route billing to attribute costs per team" and "embedding similarity tunability would reduce false positives".
Ethan P: thanks — can you add rough severity (impact x frequency)? that'll help triage.
Maya S: short list: 1) per-route billing toggle — high impact, medium freq. 2) embedding match threshold UI — medium impact, high freq. 3) per-deployment audit logs — high impact, low freq (security req).
Raj K: engineering notes — per-route billing looks tied to per-route usage meter; could expose toggle via config flag + billing tag. ETA ~2 wks for MVP with backend.
Ethan P: @alex can you weigh-in on prioritization? my gut: 1) per-route billing 2) embedding UI 3) audit logs.
Leah C: also renewal risk flag: HelixCardio mentioned they'd pause renewal if billing ambiguity not resolved. Mark as at-risk.
product-bot: New feedback card created: LINK:https://notion.redwood/feedback/cards/FB-2026-204. Assigned to @Ethan P.
Maya S: pasted raw notes below:
```
HelixCardio - needs per-route billing toggle, currently consolidates across teams, causing internal chargebacks to fail.
Sable - requests embedding similarity slider to reduce noise in reranking.
Nimbus - asked for per-deployment audit logs for compliance review.
```
Ethan P: I'll add to the feature backlog with customer impact tags and assign severity. Will also propose a quick customer-facing doc explaining interim workarounds.
Sofia G: can CS + Support queue customers for a short beta when we have an MVP? I'd handle invite list.
Raj K: +1 to beta; engineering can instrument a flag for a handful of tenants.
Leah C: great — let's sync tomorrow 10am. I'll add a calendar invite. :calendar:
Maya S: leaving the churn flag on HelixCardio, low-confidence but worth tracking.
Ben T: small ask — add sample billing export format to the feedback card so finance can review.
Ethan P: will do. Thanks all.
